prerequisites: It is recommended to have the competencies taught in the 'Foundations of Statistics' module.

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to understand fundamental questions and goals of machine learning.
Students are able to deal with special problem classes, such as supervised learning (classification and regression).
Students are able to use important machine learning methods and their scalable implementations.
Students are able to apply concepts for the evaluation of learning methods.
Students are able to independently solve practical problems using machine learning methods.
Students are able to follow scientific working methods (recognizing, formulating, solving problems, abstraction).
Students are able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion.

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions to at least two exercise assignments
Oral examination (individual examination) or written exam

assessment_rules: To acquire credits, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution to at least two exercise assignments. The final assessment is either an individual oral examination or a written exam. Grading is done on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Data Science degree program.
